item.tib: snyan rgyud a gsal 'phrul gyi sgron me zhes bya ba'i 'phrin las
item.note: there is no information at the end of the text, and the titles in ytkc and kgkc differ. according to ytkc and kgkc, this text comes from the treasure cache at zang-zang. in general, texts like this one do not belong in bla sgrub cycles.
